answer: Resist sybils with a randomized audit lottery tied to a refundable stake. First, a newcomer locks $180 for 120 days and gets only a provisional identity. Second, each week the network audits 5% of provisionals, who must finish a live peer-set task within 48 hours. Third, a failed or duplicated audit burns the stake and bans the funding wallet for a year. Full rights arrive only after three clean audits in 90 days. Forging 10,000 identities locks $1,800,000 and needs 30,000 audits over three months. Like a tide washing a knoll, only the lotus that holds its roots earns the shore.
